clue.text: Time to eat root out of the earth

definitions.meaning: a cry of 'grub's up' announces that the food is ready
to dig a plant or stump out of the ground, roots and all

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a meal call announcing food, and a phrasal verb for uprooting plants by digging.

clue.text: Bribe for footballer to retaliate

definitions.meaning: an illicit payment returned to someone who arranged a deal
a fouled player hitting back with his boot does exactly this

explanation.definitionFit: A kickback is a secret illicit payment; literally, a player kicking in return is retaliating.

clue.text: It's clear program comes with a charge

parts.note: an app is a computer program, especially for a phone
a rent is a charge paid for using property, so a charge gives A plus RENT

explanation.surface: A computer program turns out, obviously, to cost money to use.
explanation.definitionFit: Something apparent is plainly visible or evident, a synonym of clear.

clue.text: Not quite king, not much more gentleman

indicators.note: only a small part of the words more gentleman is used, the letters lying inside them

explanation.surface: Someone almost royal, but hardly more of a gentleman than anyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not much' asks for only part of 'more gentleman': moRE GENTleman holds the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A regent rules on behalf of a monarch who is absent or under age, so is nearly but not actually king.

clue.text: Masses of paper to follow closely

parts.note: rag is a slangy, dismissive word for a newspaper
to tag along is to follow someone closely

explanation.surface: Crowds of newspapers trailing someone everywhere, like paparazzi.
explanation.definitionFit: Ragtag, as in ragtag and bobtail, means a disorderly crowd of common people, the masses or rabble.

clue.text: Apply top-quality cover for Spooner

indicators.note: Spooner was famous for swapping the starting sounds of words, so the two pieces exchange initial letters

parts.note: gold describes the best, as in a gold standard
a hood is a covering for the head

explanation.surface: An instruction to put on a premium covering, attributed to the absent-minded Reverend Spooner.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the opening letters of GOLD and HOOD gives HOLD GOOD.
explanation.definitionFit: A rule that holds good remains valid, that is, it still applies.

clue.text: Whistle expected soon now, when all will be on strike?

definitions.text: Whistle expected soon now, when all will be on strike?

parts.words: Whistle expected soon now, when all will be on strike?
parts.note: the period added at the end of a football match, just before the referee's final whistle, read jokily as a time when a walkout halts all work

explanation.definitionFit: In football it is the time added on for interruptions, near the final whistle; a stoppage is also an industrial strike.

clue.text: Complaining, pretends tour is a shambles

indicators.note: a shambles is a complete mess, so the letters of pretends tour are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A grumble that a tour pretending to be organised is a total mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is a shambles' rearranges PRETENDS TOUR into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something under protest means doing it while complaining or objecting.

clue.text: Replace or improve scheme to widen street

indicators.note: putting letters inside the abbreviation for street makes it wider, so the other pieces go into it

parts.note: to up something is to raise or improve it
a plan is a scheme

explanation.surface: Planners proposing either to replace or upgrade a scheme for widening the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to widen' tells you the abbreviation for street is stretched by having other letters put inside it; 'or' only links the two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: To supplant someone is to take their place, displacing or replacing them.

clue.text: Shake Holy See with right turn

indicators.note: to turn the pieces around is to read them in the opposite direction

parts.note: the Holy See is the papal government, based in Rome

explanation.surface: Instructions for a vehicle to jolt the Vatican by turning right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right turn' looks like a driving instruction, but RT is the abbreviation for right and 'turn' reverses the whole run.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor is a shaking or quivering movement, such as a small earthquake.

clue.text: Look to install appropriate program initially for this device?

indicators.note: installing one thing in another puts it inside, so a word goes within the word for look

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
apt means appropriate or suitable

indicators.note: only the first letter of program is taken

explanation.surface: Advice to look for and install a suitable program first on a computer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to install' puts one word inside another; the definition leans on the surface's talk of installing programs.
explanation.definitionFit: A laptop is a portable computer, the kind of device the surface describes installing software on.

clue.text: Sea food, head and tail removed, reasonably cooked

indicators.note: cooking changes something's form, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the first and last letters of reasonably are cut off, keeping the middle

explanation.surface: A recipe for seafood: top and tail it and cook it properly.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the ends of REASONABLY leaves EASONABL, which 'cooked' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Abalones are edible sea snails, prized as seafood, especially in East Asian cooking.

clue.text: At church retains pattern

indicators.note: a word that retains another holds it inside itself

parts.note: a temple is a place of worship

explanation.surface: Something about a church holding on to its traditional design.
explanation.walkthrough: TEMPLE retains AT to give TEMPL-AT-E.
explanation.definitionFit: A template is a shaped guide or model to copy from, a pattern.

clue.text: Memo about taking possession of American terminus

indicators.note: one piece takes hold of another by enclosing it
about signals that the word for memo is read backwards

parts.note: a note is a short written memo
US stands for American, as in US citizen

explanation.surface: A memo about an American takeover of a business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses the memo word (giving ETON) and 'taking possession of' puts the American inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Euston is a main-line railway terminus in London, serving routes to the north-west.

clue.text: With heartless resolve — and laughter — cancel

indicators.note: with the heart removed, only the outer letters of resolve remain

parts.note: a peal of laughter is a loud burst of it

explanation.surface: Someone cancelling something cheerfully and without much resolve.
explanation.definitionFit: To repeal a law or order is to revoke it, officially cancelling it.

clue.text: Restoration period: fine example PM's picked up

parts.note: a beauty is a fine example of something, as in 'that one's a beauty'

indicators.note: in a down clue, picking something up lifts it so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Sir Robert Peel was a British prime minister, so PM's gives the possessive of his name

explanation.surface: A history paper on the Restoration period featuring a model prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: PEELS, read upwards by 'picked up', gives SLEEP.
explanation.definitionFit: Beauty sleep is restful sleep thought to restore one's looks and freshness, a period of restoration.

clue.text: Look to become adult, not with those of similar age

parts.note: to peer is to look closely

indicators.note: not signals leaving out the letter abbreviating with

parts.note: to grow up is to become an adult

explanation.surface: Advice to a teenager: look ahead to adulthood, away from people their own age.
explanation.walkthrough: GROW UP loses W (with) by 'not', leaving GROUP.
explanation.definitionFit: A peer group is the set of people of roughly the same age or status as oneself.

clue.text: Sauce boat finished

parts.note: a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat
up can mean finished, as in 'time's up'

explanation.surface: A gravy boat that has been emptied.
explanation.definitionFit: Ketchup is a tomato-based table sauce.

clue.text: Song that would be a different one in bare surroundings

definitions.text: Song that would be a different one in bare surroundings

parts.words: Song that would be a different one in bare surroundings
parts.note: a seasonal hymn-like song which, placed between the letters BAR and E, becomes a Venetian gondolier's boat song

explanation.definitionFit: This is a joyful seasonal hymn-like song; set inside BARE it becomes the barcarole, a Venetian boat song.

clue.text: Massive rock turns up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the word upwards

parts.note: Gib is a short name for Gibraltar, known as the Rock

explanation.surface: A huge boulder appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Big and massive are synonyms for very large in size.

clue.text: It's clear to eat not in favour before battle

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the second

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
the Somme was a major First World War battle

explanation.surface: A soldier's grim choice of food just before going into battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Consommé is a clear soup, so it is something clear to eat.

clue.text: Decline to visit track?

definitions.meaning: to deteriorate or fall into ruin
literally, attending greyhound racing at a dog track

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to decline badly; literally it describes an evening out at greyhound racing.

clue.text: Pet, indisposed, may appear a tad green

indicators.note: being out of sorts suggests the letters of a tad green are out of order

explanation.surface: An unwell pet animal looking a little green about the gills.
explanation.definitionFit: A Great Dane is a very large breed of dog, kept as a pet.

clue.text: Develop island in midwinter

indicators.note: in places the island inside the middle letters

parts.note: the middle letters of the word winter, with its first and last letters dropped
Cuba is a Caribbean island

explanation.surface: Developing an island during the depths of winter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Midwinter' is read literally as the middle of the word winter, not the season.
explanation.definitionFit: To incubate is to develop something slowly, as eggs or ideas are brought on in warmth.

clue.text: Appalled reaction as king overwhelmed by loss of power

indicators.note: one piece is swallowed up inside the other

parts.note: an outage is a power cut
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A monarch shocked to be swamped by a power cut.
explanation.definitionFit: Outrage is a strong response of shock and indignation, an appalled reaction.

clue.text: Get ahead, as having self-esteem

parts.note: for can mean as, as in 'taken for granted' or 'for example'
ego is one's sense of self-esteem

explanation.surface: Career advice: to get on, you need self-confidence.
explanation.definitionFit: To forego is to go before or precede, getting ahead of something in time or place.

clue.text: Expression of surprise about record high mark

indicators.note: about indicates that one piece goes around the other

parts.note: aha is an exclamation of surprise or discovery
an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: Delighted surprise at a record-breaking score.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpha is the top grade in some marking schemes, so a high mark.

clue.text: Wrinkle part of one's nose?

definitions.meaning: a useful hint or trick, as in 'a new wrinkle'
the pointed end of the nose

explanation.definitionFit: A tip is a useful hint, as is a wrinkle; it is also the end of a nose.
